quality.sourcePolicy: Chronological remix of the checked V9 1080p50 delivery. Original encoded picture packets are copied except the incoming two-second GOP at six changed joins, repaired from clean frames of the same delivered shot. No invented picture detail or optical-flow-generated frames. The bilingual mixed audio is reordered at exact sample boundaries and encoded once as AAC.
quality.runtimeFallback: HLS-only HD delivery; full-resolution review MP4s remain local because they exceed the static host per-file limit.
quality.originalMasterPolicy: Rebuilt from retained original source clips, never enlarged from the low-bitrate fallback. Native1080/4K sources and60fps originals are used where retained and traceable; lower-resolution archival footage is upscaled with Lanczos; source frame rates are resampled by selecting/repeating frames. No optical-flow-generated frames or invented archival detail.

narrationManifestRole: Original V9 synthesis provenance for the unchanged narration recordings. The active script and delivery positions are identified separately.
